provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_305: H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T], a = x^[22, 52, 54, 62, 87, 115, 117, 119, 152, 168, 171, 196, 213, 220, 263, 271], b = x^[52, 73, 79, 132, 150, 165, 196, 211, 259, 266, 280, 281, 285, 304], both sparse multiples of a designed divisor g of x^305 - 1 (hex 0x3dfd0c90c24c2fef) of degree 61, so k = 2 deg g = 122 by construction. Found by research/kit/search.py sample_cyclic_gb(6, seed=7), the designed-divisor sampler of PR #2790.
provenance.notes: Designed-divisor sampler (PR #2790, issue #2778): a and b are sparse multiples of a chosen degree-61 divisor g of x^305 - 1, so k = 2 deg g = 122 by construction. Distance: research/kit/surrogate.distance_rand_witness, fast backend, 10,000,000 trials per side, pair depth 32, seed 51, searched both sides and returned a Z logical of weight 73 with nothing lighter on either side; the single-block annihilator attack (research/kit/annihilator.py, 200,000 trials, seed 11) found weight-82 logicals on both sides and nothing lighter. The other side's witness is the image of this one under the transpose automorphism of the GB code (block swap composed with i -> -i mod 305), which maps H_X onto H_Z, so d_X = d_Z exactly. Earlier readings: 87 and 86 at 20,000 surrogate samples, 75 at 2,000,000 fast RIS trials. Witnessed upper bound, not certified. Distance revision 2026-10-09 (Perlmutter refutation campaign, witnesses by @vprusso): X side 73 -> 69 (GPU randomized information-set search (verify/ris_gpu.py, pair depth 8), 300,000,000 trials per side on an NVIDIA A100, seed 1); Z side 73 -> 71 (GPU randomized information-set search (verify/ris_gpu.py, pair depth 8), 300,000,000 trials per side on an NVIDIA A100, seed 1).
